gaps.closure_test: An implementation can exchange a semantic event without importing Estate Lab.
gaps.failure_mode: Every integration invents its own wire vocabulary.
gaps.mechanism: Public request, event, response, descriptor, submission, and registry formats.
gaps.title: Neutral interaction narrow waist

gaps.closure_test: All golden identity vectors match the Python implementation.
gaps.failure_mode: Different languages sign or replay different bytes.
gaps.mechanism: Sorted UTF-8 JSON, finite numbers, duplicate-key refusal, and SHA-256 namespaced identifiers.
gaps.title: Cross-language canonical identities

gaps.closure_test: Removing or changing any required authority field refuses before acceptance.
gaps.failure_mode: A device or model gains authority merely by producing an input.
gaps.mechanism: Authority remains explicit and immutable through an adapter.
gaps.title: Actor, role, mandate, and ownership envelope

gaps.closure_test: Duplicate bytes are idempotent, altered duplicate bytes refuse, and expired requests refuse.
gaps.failure_mode: Retries double-apply actions or stale sources regain control.
gaps.mechanism: Content-derived request/event IDs, sequence, deadline, correlation, and duplicate rule.
gaps.title: Ordering, deadline, causality, and idempotency law

gaps.closure_test: A declaration validates without an AXM manifest.
gaps.failure_mode: Discovery depends on tribal knowledge or repository-specific configuration.
gaps.mechanism: Adapter declaration names versions, profiles, bindings, capabilities, supply bytes, modalities, and authority exclusions.
gaps.title: Portable adapter self-description

gaps.closure_test: Unknown majors refuse and unknown extensions are preserved or explicitly reported.
gaps.failure_mode: Upgrades silently reinterpret fields.
gaps.mechanism: Same-major compatibility rule and explicit unknown-major/extension behavior.
gaps.title: Major-version negotiation and extension preservation

gaps.closure_test: An extension that grants authority fails review and conformance.
gaps.failure_mode: Vendor fields seize core semantics.
gaps.mechanism: Reverse-domain extension identifiers and authority non-expansion rule.
gaps.title: Namespaced extension governance

gaps.closure_test: Reference adapter passes positive and negative vectors under shell=False.
gaps.failure_mode: Adapters execute unbounded shell text or mutate semantics.
gaps.mechanism: Shell-free argv invocation with exact request and response files.
gaps.title: Reference command-json binding

gaps.closure_test: Each binding states correlation and authority carriage without changing the core envelope.
gaps.failure_mode: Each transport invents a different semantic model.
gaps.mechanism: Declared mappings for CloudEvents, AsyncAPI, MQTT, WebSocket, OSC, WIT, and WoT.
gaps.title: Protocol binding registry

gaps.closure_test: The reference adapter passes every claimed profile and negative control.
gaps.failure_mode: Compatibility remains a README claim.
gaps.mechanism: Core, replay, lifecycle, observability, supply, privacy, accessibility, and delegation profiles.
gaps.title: Public conformance profiles and vectors

gaps.closure_test: Tier projection cannot exceed verified profiles or independent evidence.
gaps.failure_mode: A single green smoke test is presented as full compatibility.
gaps.mechanism: Declared, bronze, silver, gold, platinum tiers from verified profile sets.
gaps.title: Quality tiers and badges

gaps.closure_test: Editing any identity-bearing field changes or invalidates submission_id.
gaps.failure_mode: Badges cannot be independently checked.
gaps.mechanism: Submission binds floor, descriptor, vectors, tests, tier, and evidence digests.
gaps.title: Content-addressed conformance submission

gaps.closure_test: Failed, declared-only, duplicate, or wrong-floor submissions refuse admission.
gaps.failure_mode: Discovery becomes a popularity list or vendor assertion.
gaps.mechanism: Registry admits pass plus bronze-or-higher submissions, keyed by adapter/version.
gaps.title: Portable adapter registry

gaps.closure_test: A fresh generated adapter passes the same public conformance suite.
gaps.failure_mode: Only AXM maintainers can implement the protocol.
gaps.mechanism: Generator emits stdlib adapter, descriptor, docs, and supply digest.
gaps.title: Zero-dependency adapter starter

gaps.closure_test: Closed gaps may not depend on open gaps and the dependency graph is acyclic.
gaps.failure_mode: Roadmaps relabel intentions as completion.
gaps.mechanism: Every missing layer carries mechanism, failure mode, artifact, test, owner, and dependencies.
gaps.title: Executable gap ledger

gaps.closure_test: A breaking change cannot retain the same major or vector identity.
gaps.failure_mode: A maintainer can change meaning without a migration path.
gaps.mechanism: Spec changes require vectors, compatibility statement, migration, and authority review.
gaps.title: Public change, deprecation, and extension law

gaps.closure_test: Trace context survives while response authority remains unchanged.
gaps.failure_mode: Logs become implicit proof or cannot correlate a run.
gaps.mechanism: W3C traceparent echo and structured observation profile.
gaps.title: Trace context without telemetry authority

gaps.closure_test: Descriptor and vector preserve restricted classification.
gaps.failure_mode: Adapters silently retain or downgrade sensitive payloads.
gaps.mechanism: Public/internal/confidential/restricted classes and explicit retention behavior.
gaps.title: Privacy classification and retention declaration

gaps.closure_test: Descriptor without modalities or fallback fails validation.
gaps.failure_mode: Accessible routes become undocumented side paths.
gaps.mechanism: Input/output modalities and fallbacks are first-class profile data.
gaps.title: Accessibility modalities and fallback declaration

gaps.closure_test: Delegation ID survives and may_escalate=true is refused.
gaps.failure_mode: An agent converts delegated access into broader authority.
gaps.mechanism: Delegation identity is preserved and authority escalation is forbidden.
gaps.title: Human and agent delegation boundary

gaps.closure_test: Changing adapter bytes without updating descriptor fails validation.
gaps.failure_mode: A passing name points to different code later.
gaps.mechanism: Descriptor binds license expression and artifact SHA-256.
gaps.title: License and exact implementation byte binding

gaps.closure_test: WIT package exposes one strict handle function and no ambient authority.
gaps.failure_mode: Language-neutral sandboxing remains aspirational.
gaps.mechanism: WIT world defines a sandbox-friendly request/response export.
gaps.title: WebAssembly Component Model interface

gaps.closure_test: Repeated rendering is byte-identical and binds floor_id.
gaps.failure_mode: Event-driven consumers must hand-author a second contract.
gaps.mechanism: Deterministic AsyncAPI channel projection references floor schemas.
gaps.title: AsyncAPI projection

gaps.closure_test: Independent verifier accepts gold vectors and rejects all invalid vectors.
gaps.failure_mode: Reference implementation bugs define correctness.
gaps.mechanism: A second implementation validates descriptors, vectors, submissions, and registry IDs.
gaps.title: Independent non-Python verifier

gaps.closure_test: Each SDK produces the same IDs and passes all vectors.
gaps.failure_mode: Adopters rewrite protocol code and drift.
gaps.mechanism: Generated types and canonicalization helpers from the public schemas.
gaps.title: TypeScript, Rust, and C# SDKs

gaps.closure_test: No crash, silent acceptance, or identity collision over the bounded corpus.
gaps.failure_mode: Only curated vectors are safe.
gaps.mechanism: Fuzz strict JSON, envelope validation, response mutation, and registry admission.
gaps.title: Property, mutation, and fuzz tests

gaps.closure_test: A clean host pulls and verifies the floor without Git.
gaps.failure_mode: Consumers depend on one repository layout.
gaps.mechanism: Publish spec, schemas, vectors, SDKs, and submissions as OCI artifacts.
gaps.title: OCI artifact publication

gaps.closure_test: Offline verifier binds archive, source commit, SBOM, and conformance submission.
gaps.failure_mode: A registry entry cannot prove which release produced it.
gaps.mechanism: SLSA provenance, Sigstore bundle, SPDX/CycloneDX, and offline verification.
gaps.title: Signed release and transparency evidence

gaps.closure_test: Two independent mirrors reproduce the same registry_id.
gaps.failure_mode: One maintainer controls discoverability or outage availability.
gaps.mechanism: Static registry, append-only submissions, mirrors, and revocation rows.
gaps.title: Hosted public registry and mirror protocol

gaps.closure_test: Each supplier can be installed, exercised, removed, and replaced with identical semantic receipts.
gaps.failure_mode: The floor proves only an echo adapter.
gaps.mechanism: DCS-BIOS, MobiFlight, CockpitOS, WLED, Unity Input System, and OpenXR adapters run the common vectors.
gaps.title: Live upstream reference cells

gaps.closure_test: A real device cold-boots, reconnects, and replays to identical semantic state.
gaps.failure_mode: Software evidence borrows physical credibility.
gaps.mechanism: Calibration, raw events, health, disconnect/reconnect, snapshot restoration, and independent replay.
gaps.title: Commissioned physical conformance profile

gaps.closure_test: Named user journeys pass with retained evidence and no semantic downgrade.
gaps.failure_mode: Declared modalities do not work for actual users.
gaps.mechanism: Keyboard, switch, voice, controller, screen-reader, caption, contrast, and reduced-motion trials.
gaps.title: User-tested accessibility conformance

gaps.closure_test: Concurrent jobs cannot claim the same device and every run restores baseline.
gaps.failure_mode: Physical qualification cannot scale or reproduce.
gaps.mechanism: labgrid/OpenHTF-backed inventory, lease, flash, power-cycle, capture, and cleanup.
gaps.title: Shared hardware reservation and board farm

gaps.closure_test: A clean third-party starter reaches registry admission without private instructions.
gaps.failure_mode: The registry remains effectively private.
gaps.mechanism: Template PR, automated conformance, maintainer review, revocation, and appeal process.
gaps.title: External submission and review workflow

gaps.closure_test: Every threat has a negative vector, mitigation, owner, and residual risk.
gaps.failure_mode: Conformance enables unsafe integration patterns.
gaps.mechanism: Threat model covers confused deputy, replay, injection, resource exhaustion, extension abuse, and malicious descriptors.
gaps.title: External protocol threat model and security review

gaps.closure_test: Old verifier behavior is stable and new optional fields preserve identity law.
gaps.failure_mode: Version rules exist only in prose.
gaps.mechanism: Frozen v1 vectors plus additive v1.x and rejecting v2 fixtures.
gaps.title: Backward and forward compatibility vectors

gaps.closure_test: A clean-room implementation passes vectors using only frozen documents and primitives.
gaps.failure_mode: The floor dies with its toolchain.
gaps.mechanism: Spec-only reimplementation with no package registry, service, or reference code.
gaps.title: Offline resurrection and stranded-implementer test

gaps.closure_test: Each field has purpose, retention, and crossing rules with negative tests.
gaps.failure_mode: Privacy classes do not constrain data flow.
gaps.mechanism: Map collection, storage, export, deletion, redaction, and cross-boundary movement.
gaps.title: Protocol threat and data-flow model

gaps.closure_test: Editing claimed badges cannot change verified profile computation.
gaps.failure_mode: Projects self-award compatibility logos.
gaps.mechanism: Registry and conformance receipt derive tier and badges from verified profiles.
gaps.title: Deterministic certification badge and status projection

gaps.closure_test: Reports distinguish declarations, conformance, live qualification, and replacements.
gaps.failure_mode: The floor optimizes for adoption count rather than reduced integration burden.
gaps.mechanism: Measure adapter pass rate, fault classes, upgrade burden, replacement time, and recovery.
gaps.title: Adoption, failure, and replacement metrics

scope: Public interoperability, conformance, distribution, governance, physical proof, accessibility, security, and community adoption gaps.
